name: CRM
paper_title: CRM: Single Image to 3D Textured Mesh with Convolutional Reconstruction Model
license_interpretation: The CRM code is MIT and its model card declares MIT for the weights, but CRM's two diffusion models are fine-tuned from ImageDream and MVDream, themselves from Stable Diffusion 2.1, so LibreYOLO treats the weights as under the CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M License of that lineage. OpenRAIL++-M allows commercial use, but its use-based restrictions (no illegal, harmful, discriminatory or deceptive uses, among others) bind you and must be passed on to anyone you share the model or derivatives with. LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT; the code it adapts from CRM is MIT, the FlexiCubes meshing comes from NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 release, and ImageDream parts are Apache-2.0, noted in libreyolo/models/gen/crm/NOTICE. CRM's own FlexiCubes copies with NVIDIA's all-rights-reserved header, nvdiffrast (non-commercial) and the GPL-3.0 mesh tools upstream calls are not used. The Zhengyi/CRM weights are redistributed unchanged as LibreYOLO/LibreCRM, whose card carries the OpenRAIL++-M terms; Background removal runs on LibreYOLO's BiRefNet port with the ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet weights (MIT), from LibreYOLO/LibreTRELLISl. Both are pinned and not gated.
